# A law through a projection along one run

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A determined law on a description admits a run's steps up to a step exactly where steps alike under it, by the same move, end alike; the record is the least candidate and failure persists. The image is exact on finite paths exactly where alike configurations match steps.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Some determined process on a description admits a run's steps before a step, read through the projection, exactly where any two of them from configurations alike under it, by the same move, reach configurations alike under it. The witness is the record read through the projection: it admits those steps, every process admitting them admits its steps, and it is determined exactly where they are consistent. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentThrough`, `Becoming.Run.recordThrough`, `Becoming.Run.stepsThrough_record`, `Becoming.Run.record_least`, `Becoming.Run.record_determined_iff`, `Becoming.Run.law_through_iff`)
2. Consistency up to a step holds at every earlier step, so where no determined process on the description admits the steps before a step, none admits them before any later one. Through the identity at every step the criterion is Becoming.Unfolding's consistency of a history, of which exists_law_iff is the law. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentThrough.earlier`, `Becoming.Run.no_law_later`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_id_iff`)
3. Where configurations alike under the projection go alike, every run is consistent through it at every step; the converse fails: a run staying at one configuration of a process allowing every step is consistent through the identity, and the process does not go alike. Switching's missing state law follows from the criterion along its run. (`Becoming.Run.consistent_of_goAlike`, `Becoming.Constant.process`, `Becoming.Constant.run`, `Becoming.Constant.consistent`, `Becoming.Constant.not_goAlike`, `Becoming.Switching.inconsistent`, `Becoming.Switching.no_state_law_of_criterion`)
4. The image of a process through a projection represents every finite path exactly, in the sense of GenerativeCore's projection_exact_iff, exactly where configurations alike under it match each other's steps up to it; some determined process on the description admits every step read through it and lifts each of its steps from every configuration of the fibre exactly where configurations alike go alike and match. Going alike does not give matching (Stuck); Coarse is exact through its first bit. (`Becoming.MatchesThrough`, `Becoming.image_exact_iff`, `Becoming.exact_law_iff`, `Becoming.Stuck.process`, `Becoming.Stuck.goAlike_not_matches`, `Becoming.Coarse.matching`, `Becoming.Coarse.exact_law`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the run, the projection and the step before which its steps are read; the witnesses are two-configuration processes. No axiom.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which projection an actual unfolding carries a law through, or that any formation forms or uses one.
- A law means a determined process; undetermined and random laws along a run are not treated.
- The criterion along one run is near-definitional: what it adds is the least candidate, the persistence of failure, the identity instance and the separation from the process's law.
- **Counterexample:** A run consistent where the process has no law: Constant (Constant.consistent, Constant.not_goAlike). Going alike without exactness: Stuck (Stuck.goAlike_not_matches). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LawAlongRun.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The chapter's open programme (section 8.2, Selection, causes and experiment) named "a constructive criterion along one run for a projection carrying a law" and "the bridge to GenerativeCore's exact projection"; projection-carrying-a-law left both in does_not_show. Becoming.Unfolding had the case through the identity over the whole history (Consistent, exists_law_iff); here any projection, up to any step, with the identity case as an instance. Ren, 18 October 2026: "please see what else is there to do - keep pushing the frontier till finishing" (provenance, not warrant). Reading (the AI's): a run is evidence of a law at a description exactly as far as its own steps agree; what it never visits it does not test; a law at a description is not yet a faithful model of finite paths, which needs every configuration of a class to be able to do what any of them did.
